chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Brent Sparks as road manager; two tuba players, Eppie and Pips
summary: Sparks is made road manager; the band uses two tubas, then Eppie, then Pips on string bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I'll backtrack a little bit now. Didn't Brent Sparks get in some kind of trouble, he had to go out of the band and that's when you made him like the road manager or advance man?
manager; some of the guys couldn't get along with him.
Oh, he was hard to get along with?
He didn't get into any real outside trouble.
Where did you get Eppie from. I thought Eppie was from Kansas City.
We didn't get him in Kansas City. At the time we first got Eppie, we were using two bass players.
You mean Brent Sparks and Eppie?
Brent Sparks and Eppie. When Brent left, we only kept Eppie, until we got Pips.
How were you going to work with two tuba players; that's pretty hard to work that out.
I know later on but Pips played string bass.
Yes it was, it was unusual.
It had to be unusual with two tuba players; how did you work that out?
